tapflow.order.search: 🔍 Product not in the list? Type its name to search, for example: lawn

tapflow.product.more: ✍️ Type the next product, or type anything else to stop.
tapflow.expense.pick: 🧾 Which expense? Tap below, then type only the amount. Or type it straight away, for example: rent 3000
tapflow.expense.amount: ✍️ {0} — how much was paid? Type only the amount, for example: 3000
tapflow.restock.pick: 📦 New stock arrived? Tap the product, then type how many came.
tapflow.restock.ask: 📦 {0} — how many came in? Type only the number, for example: 10
tapflow.shipped.none: 🚚 No orders are on the way right now. They show here after you ship them.

tapflow.order.repeat: 🔁 {0}'s last order: {1}. Tap below to order the same again.

tapflow.price.ask: ✏️ {0} is {1} now. Type the new price, for example: 2500
tapflow.closetime.set: 🌙 Okay: today's account will be sent every night at {0} o'clock.
tapflow.closetime.invalid: Sorry, that time was not understood. Please type an evening hour, for example: hisaab time 10
tapflow.cart.failed: Sorry, this order could not be made: {0}. Please type the items, for example: Kurta 2
